DECLARE @DOCNUM VARCHAR(30)='#LINKDOCNUM.H#'; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT TV FROM QAMAT WHERE TV='#LINKEXCELTV NO.#') BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[QAMAT] ([DOCNUM] ,[LOT] ,[TV] ,[GRDCOD] ,[GRAINSIZE] ,[DECARB] ,[HARDNESS] ,[TENSILE] ,[QAMATDOC] ,[STA] ,[CREUSR] ,[CRETIM]) VALUES ( @DOCNUM --<DOCNUM, varchar(30),> ,'#LINKEXCELHeat No.#'--<LOT, varchar(30),> ,'#LINKEXCELTV NO.#'--<TV, varchar(30),> ,'#LINKEXCELGrade Code#'--<GRDCOD, varchar(30),> ,0#LINKEXCELGrain Size#--<GRAINSIZE, decimal(18,6),> ,0#LINKEXCELDecar#--<DECARB, decimal(18,6),> ,0#LINKEXCELHardness#--<HARDNESS, decimal(18,6),> ,0--<TENSILE, decimal(18,6),> ,'#LINKEXCELDocnum#' ,'Valid'--<STA, varchar(30),> ,'#LOGIN_USER#'--<CREUSR, varchar(30),> ,GETDATE()--<CRETIM, datetime,> );
INSERT INTO QAMATELE (DOCNUM, ELECOD, ELEVAL,CREUSR,CRETIM)
SELECT @DOCNUM DOCNUM, ELECOD, ELEVAL,'#LOGIN_USER#',GETDATE()
FROM (VALUES ('C',0#LINKEXCELC#), ('Si',0#LINKEXCELSi#), ('Mn',0#LINKEXCELMn#), ('P',0#LINKEXCELP#), ('S',0#LINKEXCELS#), ('Cr',0#LINKEXCELCr#), ('Ni',0#LINKEXCELNi#), ('Mo',0#LINKEXCELMo#), ('W',0#LINKEXCELW#), ('Co',0#LINKEXCELCo#), ('V',0#LINKEXCELV#), ('Ti',0#LINKEXCELTi#), ('Cu',0#LINKEXCELCu#), ('Pb',0#LINKEXCELPb#), ('Al',0#LINKEXCELAl#), ('Nb',0#LINKEXCELNb#), ('N',0#LINKEXCELN#), ('O',0#LINKEXCELO#), ('B',0#LINKEXCELB#), ('Bi',0#LINKEXCELBi#), ('Sb',0#LINKEXCELSb#), ('H',0#LINKEXCELH#)) T (ELECOD, ELEVAL) END
